chat.title: Assistant
chat.byok_help: Bring your own {provider} API key to chat. It stays in this session, or is stored encrypted for 90 days if you check Remember.
chat.key_help: Encrypted and stored for 90 days if you check Remember; otherwise this session only. Never logged.
chat.remember: Remember on this account for 90 days
chat.key_stored: Stored encrypted on this account · expires in {days} days
chat.key_session_only: This session only — not stored on the account.
chat.panel_setup: Set up the assistant on the Chat page first — pick a provider and add your API key.
chat.api_error: The assistant is unavailable right now — try again in a moment.
chat.provider_busy: {provider} is overloaded right now — try again in a moment, or switch provider in AI settings.
chat.no_credits: Your {provider} key has no credit or quota left. Add billing in the provider's console to keep using the assistant.
chat.no_enc: Persistence off — no [chat] enc_key secret configured; key kept for this session only.
chat.free_note: Free assistant on shared daily limits — replies may come from different AI models. Add your own API key in settings for a specific provider.
chat.free_exhausted: The free assistant hit its daily capacity. Try again later, or add your own API key in settings.
chat.free_cap: You've used today's {cap} free messages. Come back tomorrow, or add your own API key in settings.
chat.free_cap_global: The free assistant has hit today's shared limit — it is used by everyone on the free chain, not just you. Try again later, or add your own API key in settings to answer right now.
chat.free_cap_trial: You've used today's {cap} welcome messages. Your allowance grows to {full} a day once your account is a day old — or add your own API key in settings to keep going now.
chat.free_ineligible: The free assistant isn't open to this account. Add your own API key in settings to use the assistant right away.
chat.import_needs_file: I can't import transactions from a message — I need the statement itself. Attach it to the chat in the app (PDF, CSV or Excel) or use the Import page and pick your broker: I read the file, show you every row, and nothing is saved until you press the import button.
chat.import_pending_hint: The rows from **{filename}** are waiting just below — check them and press the import button to save them.
chat.import_found: 📄 **{filename}** — read as {label}: **{n}** transactions ready to import. Check them below.
chat.import_found_deduped: 📄 **{filename}** — read as {label}: **{n}** new transactions ready to import. Another {dupes} are already in your book, so I left them out. Check both below.
chat.import_all_duplicates: 📄 **{filename}** — read as {label}, and all **{dupes}** of its rows are already in your book. There is nothing new to import, so I have added nothing.
chat.import_none: 📄 **{filename}** — I couldn't read any transactions out of this file.
chat.import_none_help: Export a CSV with the columns `date,ticker,action,quantity,price,currency,fee,note`, or use the Import page to pick your broker.
chat.import_positions: 📄 **{filename}** — this is a *portfolio report*: it lists what you hold right now, with no dated buys or sells in it. There is nothing to add to your ledger from it.
chat.import_positions_help: Export your trade history instead — ClickTrade/Saxo: Informes históricos → Operaciones ejecutadas → Excel; Revolut: Stocks → statement. Those carry real dates and prices. Meanwhile you can set a holding by just telling me, e.g. "I hold 112 InMode at 18.16".
chat.import_unavailable: 📄 **{filename}** — I couldn't read it because the AI backend didn't answer just now. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment, or add your own API key in AI settings.
chat.import_one_at_a_time: I only imported the first file; send {files} separately.
chat.import_broker_help: This file names no broker, so pick the one it came from — or type its name if it isn't listed. Fees and Custody group your book by it.
chat.import_duplicates: {n} already in your book — not imported
chat.import_duplicates_anyway: Import these too — only if they really are separate movements
chat.import_done: ✅ Imported {n} transactions. Your book now holds {total}.
chat.import_undo_hint: You can undo this batch from the Import page.
chat.skills_auto_hint: Auto picks the best-fitting skills for each question using your provider's cheapest model.
chat.web_help: Lets the assistant search the web (DuckDuckGo, no key needed), open the top results and read any link you paste, when a question calls for fresh information. Sources are linked under the answer.
chat.rate_limited: Too many messages at once — try again in about {seconds}s.
chat.starter_movers: What moved on my watchlist today, and why?
chat.starter_compare: Compare {a} and {b} on valuation, growth and quality.
chat.starter_earnings: Which of my watchlist stocks reports next, and what does the consensus expect?
chat.delete_confirm: Delete **{title}**? Its {n} messages go with it. This cannot be undone.
chat.skills_full: Up to {n} lenses at once — turn one off first.
chat.empty_body: It reads your {n} positions, your trade ledger and live quotes. Ask in English or Spanish.
chat.cap_analyze: **Analyse what you hold** — weight, risk, unrealised gains, dividends.
chat.cap_web: **Research with the web** — paste a link and it reads it for you.
chat.cap_import: **Import statements** — drop a broker PDF or CSV right here.
chat.cap_alerts: **Set alerts and favorites** — “tell me if NVDA drops 5%”.
chat.drop_zone: Drop a statement here — PDF, CSV or XLSX, up to {mb} MB
chat.setup_title: Start free, or bring your key
chat.setup_body: The free Aguait assistant works with nothing to configure, on shared daily limits. With your own key you pick the model and share no pot.
chat.free_cta_note: {cap} questions a day, shared · no setup
chat.byok_reassure: The key is stored encrypted and never leaves your account in the clear. You can forget it in one click.
chat.empty_body_new: It reads your {n} tickers and their live quotes. Import a statement and it reads your book too.
chat.starter_summary: Summarise my portfolio in five lines
